courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Application of Linguistics in the Teaching of Chinese
courses.description: This course is founded on traditional Chinese linguistics while also covering recent advances in the field. Aiming to link subject knowledge and language teaching pedagogy, the course explores application of pedagogical content knowledge in the classroom. Topics covered include (1) etymology and language teaching; (2) phonology and language learning; (3) lexicology, annotation study and language learning; (4) grammar and language learning; (5) rhetoric, pragmatics and language learning.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
- 掌握語言學、語言教學、漢語語言學基礎理論知識。
- 掌握相關理論在語文課堂教學中的應用。
- 掌握依據相關理論進行語文教學的設計及評鑒。
- 了解立足香港的中文教育對中文教師的各項要求。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Theories of Chinese Literature in the Teaching of Chinese
courses.description: Literature learning is an integral part of Chinese language education, and strengthening literature studies is a key task in the development of the Chinese language curriculum. This course will explore in detail theories of literature, literary writing, and literary appreciation and criticism; and how such theories can be applied in Chinese teaching to enhance its quality. To cater for the corresponding developments in the curriculum, this course will also cover topics on local and children’s literature. This enables participants to have a good understanding of the relevant teaching materials and teaching methods and to apply this knowledge for effective teaching.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本課程後，學員將能夠：
1. 理解文學教學與語文教學的關係；

2. 掌握中國文學理論與西方文學理論的基本特質；

3. 掌握中國文學作品賞析的基本原則；

4. 掌握各體文學作品賞析的基本方法；

5. 掌握中國文學教學設計的原則及方法。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Chinese Culture and the Teaching of Chinese
courses.description: The aim of this course is to strengthen participants’ knowledge and effectiveness of Chinese Language teaching through a close examination of the relationship between Chinese Language teaching and Chinese culture. The course starts with an investigation of the general relationship between culture, education, and pedagogy. It will then look into the objectives and contents of the teaching of Chinese through its language system and various cultural domains, such as ethics, moral studies, philosophy, education, literature, traditional politics, etc. Based on the traditional and contemporary theories of literature, appropriate teaching materials and teaching methods will be explored.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本課程後，學員將能夠 ：
1. 理解中國文化與中文教學的關係 ；

2. 掌握中國文化的基本特質；

3. 掌握中國文學教設計的原則及方法。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Chinese Language Curriculum: Theories and Practices
courses.description: This course aims to enhance students’ ability in developing and improving the Chinese language curriculum in their schools through introducing the theories and practices of Chinese language curriculum design and implementation. Topics covered include: the evolution of the Hong Kong Chinese language curriculum; basic concepts, content, and characteristics of the current Hong Kong Chinese language curriculum; historical background, concepts and models of school-based curriculum development; theories and practices of module design and curriculum organization; and implementation and evaluation of school-based curriculum.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能：

1. 認識語文課程的主要理論、概念及原則；
2. 了解香港中國語文科課程的理念、內涵和特點；
3. 掌握校本課程發展的核心價值及相關分析架構和概念；
4. 掌握校本課程評鑑的特點和方法；
5. 分析影響校本課程發展和實施的因素及其相互關係；
6. 運用所學，設計、優化或評鑑己校的中文科課程，並提出改善建議。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Theories of Listening and Reading in Chinese Language Teaching
courses.description: This course aims to introduce theories of, and research on, listening and reading in relation to Chinese language teaching. Topics for presentation and discussion include: (1) development of ability in listening and reading; (2) the cognitive processes of listening and reading; (3) factors affecting the ability in listening and reading; (4) strategies for listening and reading comprehension; (5) assessment of students’ ability in listening and reading; (6) catering for individual differences in listening and reading instruction; (7) cultivating students’ self-learning ability in listening and reading; (8) developing students’ listening and reading habits.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科的學習後，學員應具備以下的知識、能力或態度：
1. 對閱讀與聆聽過程的理論以及這些理論與中文科教學的關係有清楚的認識；

2. 對中西方閱讀與聆聽教學的不同模式有全面的認識；

3. 能夠結合理論以及個人教學經驗積極反思不同閱讀與聆聽教學模式的優點和限制；

4. 掌握閱讀與聆聽教學的理論和方法，並能應用在日常相關的教學上；

5. 掌握閱讀與聆聽評估的理論和方法，並能應用在日常的評估工作上。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Theories of Elocution and Writing in Chinese Language Teaching
courses.description: This course aims to introduce theories of, and research on, elocution & writing with reference to Chinese language teaching. Topics for presentation and discussion include: (1) development of the ability of elocution & writing; (2) cognitive processes of elocution and writing; (3) factors affecting performance in elocution and writing; (4) strategies for elocution and writing; (5) assessment of elocution and writing ability; (6) catering for individual differences in the teaching of elocution and writing; (7) fostering students’ self-learning ability in elocution and writing.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能：
1. 說明說話和寫作能力的發展過程及其與教學的關係；
2. 說明說話和寫作課程、教學及評估的主要理論、概念、設計原則及策略；
3. 應用相關的能力發展及教學理論，聯繫個人學習與教學經驗，以：
• 設計及／或評價說話及寫作課程設計；
• 設計及／或評價說話及寫作教學和評估策略；
• 分析香港語文課程中說話及寫作教學的理念、內涵及實施策略；
• 分析香港語文課程中說話及寫作教學實施情況。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Putonghua and Chinese Teaching
courses.description: In Hong Kong, the Chinese subject is normally delivered through the Cantonese dialect as the medium of instruction. Some people consider using Cantonese to teach standard written Chinese a hindrance to language learning. Since teaching Chinese through Putonghua will be a major development in Chinese curriculum reform in Hong Kong, this course explores both the advantages and disadvantages of teaching Chinese in Putonghua. Furthermore, the course also examines adjustments in course design, objectives, content, materials design and development as well as teaching approaches that need to be made in support of the development.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
• 從宏觀角度瞭解普教中目前的實施狀況。
• 認識普教中在教學語言方面對老師和學生提出的要求。
• 了解中、小學普教中校本課程的設計、實施及評核。
• 掌握實施課堂教學活動的策略。
• 從課程設計、課堂管理、教學實施及學生學習等不同層面了解普教中教師的教學困難和憂慮，並探討解決困難的策略和方法。
• 學習和掌握普通話語用功能、關注個別差異、課堂生生互動、校本課程設計和實施等相關理論及其教學實踐。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Seminar in Chinese Language Teaching: Special Topics
courses.description: This course is designed for students who wish to have in-depth explorations of special topics in Chinese language teaching. Different topics focus on those areas not yet covered in the regular programme of studies, such as teaching of literature writing, integrating drama in Chinese language teaching, teaching of integrated language skills, catering individual differences, multi-media support for language teaching and teaching of moral and civic values, will be offered in different cohorts. The design of this course provides flexibility to utilize the expertise of different teaching staffs and to broaden students' exploration in different areas of Chinese language teaching.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能：
1. 深入理解及分析與該中國語文教學專題研習主題相關的研究文獻及理論；
2. 聯繫個人學習與教學經驗，於語文教學場景中應用於該教學專題研習中學習的教學理論及技巧。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcomes as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Project and Research Report: Chinese Language Education
courses.description: In their second year of study, participants are expected to conduct a small project or research study within the area of Chinese language education under the guidance of their supervisors. In general, this project or research may employ either quantitative or qualitative methods, such as surveys, experimental studies, action research, or case studies. Students are required to complete a report which conforms to the format and requirements stipulated by the Faculty. The exact topics of the project or study and the supervision schedules are to be discussed between supervisors and participants.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
After taking this course, students will be able to:
1. Demonstrate the application of knowledge and method to the investigation of a specific area within the field of Chinese Language Education.
2. Identify an issue to which solutions and/or recommendations can be addressed; and produce a written report which sets out clearly the aims, context, content and outcome.
3. Integrate the skills and knowledge which have been taught in the degree programme with specific application to a topic to produce a well-argued report.

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Current Issues of Chinese Language Education
courses.description: This course is designed to enrich students' understanding of current trends in Chinese language education. Different new issues arise from the curriculum reform, such as project-based learning, life-wide learning in Chinese language education, school-based assessment, school-based curriculum development and elective modules of new senior secondary Chinese language curriculum, will be chosen as major topics in this course. It aims to develop students' professional ability to apply the new educational theories and concepts in their daily Chinese language teaching under the continuous changing curriculum.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科學習後，學員應：
• 掌握校本課程發展的核心價值及相關分析框架和概念；
• 認識香港中文科校本課程發展的背景、歷史和當前議題；
• 掌握單元課程和校本課程評鑑的特點和設計方法，及其與中文科校本課程發展的關係；
• 認識影響校本課程發展和實施的因素及其相互關係；
• 運用所學，設計、優化或評鑑己校校本課程，或分析己校校本課程發展，並提出改善建議。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Teaching Thinking in Chinese Language Education
courses.description: "Thinking" is one of the nine learning areas of the Chinese language curriculum in Hong Kong. This course is mainly designed to enhance Chinese language teachers' professional ability in thinking teaching. It aims to help teachers to design and implement thinking teaching effectively in Chinese language teaching to develop students' higher-order language skills and independent thinking ability. Topics covered included instructional strategies for enhancing students' thinking skills; fostering metacognition; teaching critical thinking, creative thinking and problem solving skills; assessing thinking ability. The basic concepts, theories and classroom applications of all these topics will be introduced and discussed in the course to help teachers to integrate thinking teaching in their daily teaching to develop students' thinking skills in different areas.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科的學習後，學員應具備以下的知識、能力或態度：
1. 對不同的思維教學理論有清楚的認識；
2. 掌握有效促進學生的思維能力發展的教學和評估策略；
3. 提升專業能力，設計和施行有助促進學生批判思維、創意思維和解難思維的校本課程；
4. 能夠將思維教學的元素融入中文科不同的教學範疇上；
5. 能夠運用有效的方法評估學生的思維能力。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Chinese Language Assessment
courses.description: This course provides participants' with theories, concepts, techniques, practices of Chinese language assessment, and an overview of its development in Hong Kong. Topics include: (1) basic concepts and principles of educational measurement and assessment; (2) concepts, principles, and methods of language assessment; (3) procedures for construction and appraisal of test items of language assessment; (4) issues in interpretation and uses of test results, and (5) specific topics related to Chinese language assessment in educational reform, such as Basic Competency Assessment, Learning Outcome Framework, school-based assessment, and assessment in the new senior secondary education.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能：
1. 說明語文評估的主要理論、概念及原則；
2. 說明香港中國語文評估的發展概況；
3. 應用課程設計、實施及/或評估理論，聯繫個人學習與教學經驗，以：
• 分析中國語文評估的理念、內涵及方法；
• 設計及／或評價不同的語文評估方法。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)

courses.subject: MCLE
courses.title: Teaching Chinese as a Second Language
courses.description: Through exploring the teaching and learning of Chinese as a second language (CSL), this course aims to enhance teachers’ knowledge and skills in teaching CSL in Hong Kong’s education system. The course content mainly includes: an overview of CSL education in Hong Kong, theories of CSL teaching, teaching methods for CSL, Chinese literacy support in mainstream classrooms, and assessment of CSL.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA Chinese Language Education
courses.learning_outcomes:
修習本科後，學員能夠：
• 闡述在香港第二語言中文的學與教背景和現狀。
• 利用中文作為第二語言的理論基礎指導教學。
• 運用第二語言教育的教學方法進行課堂教學。
• 支持非華語學生在主流中文學習中的讀寫能力發展。
• 利用合理的評估方法促進學生的中文學習。
• 反思和評論自己和己校的中文二語教學與課程。

(Individual course teachers may update the learning outcome as and whenever necessary.)
